core_memory.club_experiences: Joined the Computer Science Society during freshman year. Weekly meetups, discussions on new technologies, sharing projects, and industry speakers. Helpful for learning concurrency and containerization.
core_memory.vr_ar_club: Attending since sophomore year. Hands-on club with a VR lab. Hosts demos of projects like mini-games and AR interfaces(e.g., AR tutor for advanced math). Supportive vibe and inspires creativity due to genuine excitement about emerging tech.
core_memory.student_radio_events: Attends open-mic nights at the student-run radio station. Features singing, poetry readings, and stand-up comedy. Reminds you that people have hidden talents beyond their usual roles(e.g., friend from Distributed Systems performing acoustic music).
core_memory.campus_spots: Central lawn: Student organizations set up booths, hand out freebies(stickers, candy, pizza). Annual Tech Fest: Project teams showcase prototypes, recruiters scout for innovative ideas. Important for engineering and CS students.
core_memory.dorm_life: Lived in ‘Engi-House’ dorm for first two years(engineering majors). Legendary late-night coding sessions in the common lounge. Streaming e-sports, occasional intensity due to stressed-out engineers. Potlucks, Netflix, and talent shows for stress relief.
core_memory.outreach_volunteering: Volunteers at ‘Tech for Good’ day, helping local high school students learn programming and problem-solving. Runs mini-workshops on web development and Python. Rewarding to see younger students learn and get excited about STEM fields.
core_memory.social_scene: Lively social scene with Greek life and specialized clubs as primary ways to meet people. Robotics Team: Found a second family. Closer to folks in VR/AR Club and CS Society, sharing both academic and casual conversations(jokes, complaints, weekend plans).
